items.source: request - current HTTP request
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求

items.source: Detects include request URL if called within a RequestDispatcher include.
items.translation: 如果在 RequestDispatcher 的 include 中调用，则检测包含请求的 URL。

items.source: As the value returned by request.getContextPath() is not decoded by the servlet container, this method will decode it.
items.translation: 由于 `request.getContextPath()` 返回的值不会被 Servlet 容器解码，此方法将对其进行解码。

items.source: Decode the given matrix variables via decodeRequestString(HttpServletRequest, String) unless setUrlDecode(boolean) is set to true in which case it is assumed the URL path from which the variables were extracted is already decoded through a call to getLookupPathForRequest(HttpServletRequest).
items.translation: 通过decodeRequestString(HttpServletRequest, String)解码给定的矩阵变量，除非在setUrlDecode(boolean)中将其设置为true，在这种情况下，假设通过调用getLookupPathForRequest(HttpServletRequest)已经解码了提取变量的 URL 路径。

items.source: Decode the given URI path variables via decodeRequestString(HttpServletRequest, String) unless setUrlDecode(boolean) is set to true in which case it is assumed the URL path from which the variables were extracted is already decoded through a call to getLookupPathForRequest(HttpServletRequest).
items.translation: 通过decodeRequestString(HttpServletRequest, String)解码给定的 URI 路径变量，除非在setUrlDecode(boolean)中将其设置为true，在这种情况下，假设提取变量的 URL 路径已通过调用getLookupPathForRequest(HttpServletRequest)进行了解码。

items.source: Resolve the lookupPath and cache it in a request attribute with the key PATH_ATTRIBUTE for subsequent access via getResolvedLookupPath(ServletRequest).
items.translation: Resolve 查找路径并将其缓存在具有键 PATH_ATTRIBUTE 的请求属性中，以便后续通过 getResolvedLookupPath(ServletRequest) 访问。

items.source: Name of Servlet request attribute that holds a resolved lookupPath.
items.translation: 持有 `resolved` 查找路径的 Servlet 请求属性名称。

items.source: Return a previously resolved lookupPath.
items.translation: 返回之前resolved的查找路径。

items.source: vars - the URI variables extracted from the URL path
items.translation: vars - 从 URL 路径中提取的 URI 变量

items.source: the path within the servlet mapping, or ""
items.translation: servlet 映射中的路径，或""

items.source: the context path
items.translation: 上下文路径

items.source: the servlet path
items.translation: servlet 路径

items.source: the same Map or a new Map instance
items.translation: 相同的 Map 或新的 Map 实例

items.source: Used by AbstractUrlHandlerMapping and RequestContext for path matching and/or URI determination.
items.translation: 由 `AbstractUrlHandlerMapping` 和 `RequestContext` 用于路径匹配和/或 URI 确定。

items.source: Note: Be aware the servlet path will not match when compared to encoded paths. Therefore use of urlDecode=false is not compatible with a prefix-based Servlet mapping and likewise implies also setting alwaysUseFullPath=true.
items.translation: 注意： 请注意，当与编码路径进行比较时，servlet 路径将不匹配。因此，使用 urlDecode=false 与基于前缀的 Servlet 映射不兼容，并且同样意味着需要设置 alwaysUseFullPath=true。

items.source: As the value returned by request.getRequestURI() is not decoded by the servlet container, this method will decode it.
items.translation: 由于 `request.getRequestURI()` 返回的值不会被 Servlet 容器解码，此方法将对其进行解码。

items.source: If the request specifies a character encoding itself, the request encoding will override this setting. This also allows for generically overriding the character encoding in a filter that invokes the ServletRequest.setCharacterEncoding method.
items.translation: 如果请求本身指定了字符编码，则请求的编码将覆盖此设置。这也允许在调用 `ServletRequest.setCharacterEncoding` 方法的过滤器中通用地覆盖字符编码。

items.source: The URI that the web container resolves should be correct, but some containers like JBoss/Jetty incorrectly include ";" strings like ";jsessionid" in the URI. This method cuts off such incorrect appendices.
items.translation: Web 容器解析的 URI应该是正确的，但某些容器（如 JBoss/Jetty）会错误地在 URI 中包含类似";jsessionid"的字符串。此方法会截断此类不正确的附加内容。

items.source: As the value returned by request.getServletPath() is already decoded by the servlet container, this method will not attempt to decode it.
items.translation: 由于 `request.getServletPath()` 返回的值已经由 Servlet 容器解码，此方法不会尝试对其进行解码。

items.source: The default implementation uses URLDecoder.decode(input, enc).
items.translation: 默认实现使用 `URLDecoder.decode(input, enc)`。

items.source:
If set to false the path within the current servlet mapping
is used instead if applicable (i.e. in the case of a prefix based Servlet
mapping such as "/myServlet/*").
items.translation: 如果设置为 false，则在适用的情况下（即在基于前缀的 Servlet 映射（如"/myServlet/*"）的情况下）使用当前 servlet 映射内的路径。

items.source: By default this is set to "false".
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为"false"。

items.source:
Either the request encoding or the default Servlet spec encoding
(ISO-8859-1) is used when set to "true".
items.translation: 当设置为"true"时，将使用请求编码或默认 Servlet 规范编码 (ISO-8859-1)。

items.source: By default this is set to true.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 true。

items.source: For example: servlet mapping = "/*"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/test/a".
items.translation: 例如：servlet mapping = "/*"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/test/a"。

items.source: For example: servlet mapping = "/"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/test/a".
items.translation: 例如：servlet 映射 = "/"；请求 URI = "/test/a" → "/test/a"。

items.source: For example: servlet mapping = "/test/*"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/a".
items.translation: 例如：servlet mapping = "/test/*"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/a"。

items.source: For example: servlet mapping = "/test"; request URI = "/test" → "".
items.translation: 例如：servlet mapping = "/test"; request URI = "/test" → ""。

items.source: For example: servlet mapping = "/*.test"; request URI = "/a.test" → "".
items.translation: 例如：servlet mapping = "/*.test"；request URI = "/a.test" → ""。

items.source:
The default implementation checks the request encoding,
falling back to the default encoding specified for this resolver.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查请求编码，若未指定则回退到此解析器指定的默认编码。

items.source:
Shared, read-only instance with defaults. The following apply:
  • alwaysUseFullPath=false
  • urlDecode=true
  • removeSemicolon=true
  • defaultEncoding=WebUtils.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ENCODING
items.translation:
共享的只读实例，使用默认值。适用如下设置：
  • alwaysUseFullPath=false
  • urlDecode=true
  • removeSemicolon=true
  • defaultEncoding=WebUtils.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ENCODING

items.source:
Shared, read-only instance for the full, encoded path. The following apply:
  • alwaysUseFullPath=true
  • urlDecode=false
  • removeSemicolon=false
  • defaultEncoding=WebUtils.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ENCODING
items.translation:
共享的只读实例，用于完整的编码路径。适用以下规则：
  • alwaysUseFullPath=true
  • urlDecode=false
  • removeSemicolon=false
  • defaultEncoding=WebUtils.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ENCODING

items.source: Remove ";" (semicolon) content from the given request URI if the removeSemicolonContent property is set to "true".
items.translation: 如果 `removeSemicolonContent` 属性设置为 "true"，则从给定的请求 URI 中移除 ";" (分号) 内容。

items.source: Remove ";" (semicolon) content from the given request URI if the removeSemicolonContent property is set to "true". Note that "jsessionid" is always removed.
items.translation: 如果将 `removeSemicolonContent` 属性设置为 "true"，则从给定的请求 URI 中移除 ";" (分号) 内容。请注意，"jsessionid" 始终会被移除。

Return the path within the servlet mapping for the given request,

or "" if the whole URL has been used to identify the servlet.

Return the request URI for the given request. If this is a forwarded request,

items.translation: 返回给定请求的请求 URI。如果这是转发请求，则正确解析为原始请求的请求 URI。
